subject: Review Secretariat: timeline, manager handoffs, and secure comms
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPath HR <consultant@brightpathhr.com>, Emma Davis <emma.davis@lawfirm.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Review Secretariat: timeline, manager handoffs, and secure comms

Team —

I pulled together an initial secretariat checklist for this year's review window. The core ask: agree the timeline, confirm who owns manager handover packets, and lock down the secure communications channel for privileged cases. BrightPath is copied to confirm HR support windows; Emma for a quick legal sanity check on the redaction checklist.

High-level proposal (attached):
- Timeline: review window opens 2026-10-03, calibration week 2026-11-14, manager sign-off by 2026-11-21.
- Manager Handover Packets: completed for any role with anticipated org change or off-cycle performance action. Packet owner: manager -> people ops reviewer -> OLGA archive.
- Secure comms: a sealed mailing list (review-secretariat@redwood.com) + ephemeral Drive folder with explicit access and redaction flagging.

Action items to close this week:
1) Marcus: confirm capacity for manager 1:1 calibrations and pick preferred calibration week dates.
2) Laura: review the redaction checklist (attached) and flag any legal or compliance gaps.
3) Vivek: confirm senior leadership comms cadence and whether any roles are in silent mode.
4) BrightPath: provide availability windows for sensitive-case intake and recommended evidence templates.

Attachments: Manager_Handover_Packet_v2.pdf, Redaction_Checklist.xlsx, Timeline_2026Q4_GA.ics

Thanks — I kept the note intentionally small so managers can forward into their bundles.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of People Operations (Interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPath HR <consultant@brightpathhr.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Review Secretariat: timeline, manager handoffs, and secure comms

Olga —

Thanks for the clear note. Quick answers:
- Calibration week OK on 2026-11-14; prefer we keep 11/14–11/18 as the window (gives some overlap with managers who need flexibility).
- Manager handover packets: I'll ask all EMs to populate Manager_Handover_Packet by 2026-10-20. I'll nominate a backup reviewer per org.
- For silent-mode roles: a handful in infra and platform leadership. I'll send you the list by EOD Wednesday.

One operational ask: can we add a short expected file naming convention in the packet template (team_role_manager-lastname_date.pdf)? That reduces redaction mistakes when archiving.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP Engineering, Model Serving
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Davis <emma.davis@lawfirm.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Review Secretariat: timeline, manager handoffs, and secure comms

Olga / Marcus —

I've skimmed the Redaction_Checklist and have a few suggestions before we publish:
- Add a mandatory PII sweep step for manager packets (names + SSN/national id, personal addresses).
- Define retention: manager packets that include performance remediation notes should be retained for 6 years in encrypted archive; others 2 years.
- For sealed communications, recommend a short activity log (who accessed, when) exported weekly to an audit bucket.

Emma, can you confirm whether the two-tier retention policy requires an update to our data retention policy or if an internal SOP is sufficient?

Laura Bennett
Chief Legal Counsel, Employment
Redwood Inference
From: BrightPath HR <consultant@brightpathhr.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Review Secretariat: timeline, manager handoffs, and secure comms

Hi all —

Thanks for the invite. Availability for sensitive-case intake: 2026-10-04 through 2026-10-15 and again 2026-11-01–2026-11-10. We can provide two 90-minute calibration workshops for managers (best practice facilitation + redaction training).

We recommend the following evidence templates for manager packets: performance summary (1 page), meeting notes (dated, with participant initials), and any PII redaction summary. We'll upload templates to the Drive folder.

Best,
Aarti Shah
Senior Consultant, BrightPath HR
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPath HR <consultant@brightpathhr.com>, Emma Davis <emma.davis@lawfirm.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 16:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Review Secretariat: timeline, manager handoffs, and secure comms

Thanks everyone — this is helpful. Quick follow-up and final asks before I publish the secretariat pack on Wednesday morning:

1) Marcus: please share the silent-mode role list by 2026-07-22 5pm PT.
2) Laura / Emma: confirm whether retention policy requires an update or if an SOP will suffice by 2026-07-23.
3) BrightPath: please drop the two packet templates and two workshop slots into the Drive folder; I'll gate access as required.

I updated the Drive folder with a naming-convention guidance doc and a blank Manager_Handover_Packet template (see link below). I will circulate a single-manager email template managers can forward to direct reports when requesting documentation to minimize language variance.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-review-secretariat

Once the above are confirmed I will: publish the sealed comms address, create the ephemeral folder with restricted access, and circulate the final sign-off form for leadership.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
